svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.oxygen-reservoir-flow-context", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "One introduced atmospheric oxygen-gas exchange context: a green plant supplies oxygen through oxygenic photosynthesis while both that plant and an aerobic animal consume oxygen in respiration. Restricted gas-exchange context, not a closed global oxygen-matter budget, mass-balanced chemical reaction diagram, energy cycle, breathing-anatomy model or full ecosystem web. Water/organic matter/carbon dioxide reservoirs, light input, dissolved oxygen, decomposers, combustion, oxidation and transport are omitted, not denied. Two opposed green-plant links distinguish processes, not equal gross rates or fixed net flux. Nodes/arrow widths do not encode quantities; no timing, night/day rate or numeric oxygen share is claimed. Teacher/audio positional and process keys are essential; independently recognisable chemical symbols are not asserted.", "geometry_exception": "Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard. Reservoir-frame corners and arrowhead tips retained as logical anchors. Continuous Swell/ViewPlus paths shared; no Braille or touch-recognition result.", "physical_evaluation": "pending", "arrow_repair": {"source": "BANA2022section3.4.3.7", "construction": "Open equilateral head,12mm sides/base;9mm shaft-to-apex separation gives3.1mm nominal edge clearance for1.4mm strokes. The additional gap protects clear separation at nominal scale; no physical proof claimed.", "old_master": "tactile/masters/education/science/ecology/oxygen-reservoir-flow-context.svg", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard, logical junctions de-duplicated. Optional near-junction samples may be omitted; node frames and directed head anchors retained. Not Braille or actual tactile recognition.
